Did you connect to Riyad Bank successfully from the first time?
Dial the official Riyad Bank call center number. Document if the call connects on the first attempt without busy signals, disconnections, or network errors.
If you encountered issues during your initial attempt to connect, please mention the reason
Please record the number of attempts you made until the call successfully connected without any issues
Did you face any issues with your interaction with the IVR menu?

Examples of issues: IVR not responding to keypad inputs, call routed to the incorrect department, language selection not functioning properly, or the call dropped/disconnected while entering options in the IVR.
Was it easy to understand and follow the IVR?
Evaluate based on: clarity of instructions, logical menu structure, appropriate pacing, and successful navigation to the desired option.
Was the 'CSR agent' option clearly defined and easy to find on the IVR menu?
Were you able to sign in to the Phone Banking service successfully?

After navigating to the Phone Banking option in the IVR, attempt to authenticate. Document the authentication method required, number of digits requested for PIN, additional security questions, and whether you received confirmation of successful login.
If you encountered issues connecting via phone banking, please mention the reason
Monitor for common banking system issues such as network interruptions or delayed responses. Document if OTP delivery is delayed or the system disconnects during authentication. Note any outages.
Was your call successfully connected to a CSR on the first attempt after selecting the 'CSR' option from the IVR?
Please record the number of attempts you made until the call successfully connected without any issues
Please record the waiting time per attempt
Were you able to reach the CSR within 4 seconds? (خلال 4 ثواني)
Riyad Bank to confirm established SLAs for reaching the agent.
In case you have waited, did the CSR apologize for the waiting time?
Did the CSR mention Riyad Bank's name in the greeting?
Did the CSR state their own name?
Did the CSR ask 'How can I help you'?
Did the agent ask you for your name?
Was the CSR able to communicate in the language you prefer (Arabic or English)?
If the CSR wasn't able to communicate in your preferred language on the first attempt, select what applied
options: You were redirected to the IVR menu to choose the language again
The call was cut off with no clear reason

Evaluate if the agent correctly understood and articulated your problem; summarized it accurately; identified the root cause.
Did the CSR show any empathy towards your complaint by apologizing or showing that they understand your frustration?

Did the agent try to provide you with a solution first before raising the complaint?
